question: Which accepted retail Unique Era Ability effects have effect-specific native owner evidence sufficient to classify them before another extension?

scope.boundary: This topic classifies only effect-specific owners supported by accepted manifests, catalogs, bounded current-image queries, and narrow generated-code evidence. A literal UEA request in the accepted 95-site lookup inventory is a seed, not effect ownership. The topic does not choose a synthetic UEA, design an ABI, claim complete UI or AI parity, or authorize implementation.

dependencies.use: Provides the accepted 16 by 4 retail table, cumulative lookup, and complete 95-site generated call inventory.
Provides the accepted shared producer and bounded consumers for half-cost unit-production UEAs.
Provides the accepted producer-consumer path for UEA 35.
Identifies the UEA25 city Gold contribution separately from its sixteen rate consumers and three unrelated AI valuation consumers.
Provides the accepted hard-coded UEA-to-technology branches and ordinary ownership boundary.
Provides the accepted UEA 47 reserve mutation and read-side aggregate paths.
Provides the accepted UEA 8 city-growth threshold adjustment and bounded city-update consumer.
Provides the accepted base movement field, effective movement accessor, three retail movement UEA owners, and merged-call inventory correction.
Provides the accepted UEA 1 road-cost owner and matching city-update half-cost consumer.
Provides the accepted UEA 50 new-Warrior veteran-level increment and saturation path.
Provides the accepted unit-definition table, Cannon UnitType 17, base-attack field, effective attack accessor, and bounded combat and AI consumers.

classificationContract.sharedCumulativeLookup: An accepted effect-specific producer calls ActiveCivilizationBonusLookup with the retail UEA ID and consumes the result for the named effect.
classificationContract.directCivilizationEffectPath: The native effect is selected by a civilization or effect-specific path that bypasses ActiveCivilizationBonusLookup for that UEA ID.
classificationContract.mixedCompanionPath: One complete extension effect requires both shared lookup composition and a separately proved direct companion path. This class is not inferred for native retail cells from a lookup call alone.
classificationContract.unknown: No accepted effect-specific producer-consumer packet establishes the native owner. A player-facing label, retail table placement, or literal lookup request is insufficient.

lookupInventorySeed.qualification: Literal presence includes values proved on merged common callsites, including UEA 12, 16, and 28. It proves only that some accepted caller asks the shared lookup about the numeric ID. It does not by itself prove the player-facing effect, complete native owner, absence of a direct companion, or behavioral portability. Literal absence is also not proof of a direct owner; only UEA 40 has a separately mapped direct path.

sharedCumulativeLookup.effect: Desert tiles provide +1 Food and +1 Trade

directCivilizationEffectPath.result: The capture path compares the new owner's civilization with Mongolian civilization 14 and does not call ActiveCivilizationBonusLookup for UEA 40.

retailCellProjection.rule: Apply each UEA ID's owner class to every occurrence of that ID in the accepted 16 by 4 row table.
retailCellProjection.qualification: The 45 distinct retail IDs comprise 32 shared IDs, one direct ID, no accepted native mixed ID, and 12 unknown IDs. UEA 12, UEA 17, UEA 20, and UEA 23 each occupy two retail cells; UEA 1, UEA 25, UEA 42, and UEA 47 each occupy three; the six terrain-yield IDs occupy nine cells; every other currently classified ID occupies one.

effectDataflow.result: When UnitType is 17 and cumulative UEA 13 is active, the accessor adds two to the retained effective attack value before returning.

currentEvidence.method: One foreground read-only 15-word current-image query centered at 0x82CF2384, exact branch-target decoding, and narrow generated-code corroboration of 0x82CF2230.

uea13.qualification: This static owner path establishes the UnitType predicate, cumulative lookup, and +2 effective-attack composition. It does not prove runtime execution, presentation, persistence provenance, every attack modifier, or general AI strategy.

effectDataflow.result: The baseline path adds retained signed contribution r18 to the indexed table word. When cumulative UEA 23 is active, the same path adds signed r18 divided by two with truncation toward zero to that word a second time. For a nonnegative contribution this yields r18 + floor(r18 / 2).

currentEvidence.method: One foreground read-only 31-word current-image query centered at 0x82D15618, exact branch-target decoding, and narrow generated-code corroboration of 0x82D13978.

greatPersonGenerationOwner.qualification: This static effect-specific path establishes the cumulative UEA 23 gate and exact extra half-contribution arithmetic. It does not name the enclosing function or table layout, prove the provenance or allowed range of r18, enumerate every Great Person producer or consumer, or establish runtime, presentation, AI, save, scenario, or multiplayer behavior.

effectDataflow.result: When the local 0x8 flag is clear and the indexed state word is zero, an active cumulative UEA 42 result branches around a block that otherwise writes retained zero r22 to four indexed halfword fields and the associated retained locals.

currentEvidence.method: One foreground read-only 31-word current-image query centered at 0x82D15344, exact branch-target decoding, and narrow generated-code corroboration of 0x82D13978 including the converging r22 zero assignments.

anarchyImmunityOwner.qualification: This static effect-specific path establishes one cumulative UEA 42 gate that preserves four local halfword values by bypassing their zeroing block. It does not name the enclosing function, dynamic field offsets, flag, indexed state word, or halfword meanings; prove that this is every Anarchy path; or establish runtime, presentation, AI, save, scenario, or multiplayer behavior.

mongolianRegression.failedInference: Replacing the player-facing UEA 40 cell in the shared cumulative lookup was treated as proof that village conversion used that lookup.
mongolianRegression.observedFailure: The synthetic Horseback Riding grant activated, but village capture still converted because the native effect owner bypassed the lookup.

acceptedExtensionShape.sharedSide: CalendarTurnAdvance grants ordinary Horseback Riding ownership after the synthetic cumulative lookup succeeds.
acceptedExtensionShape.directSide: A companion gate at 0x82D1B758 suppresses only the direct Mongolian village-conversion branch when the Ancient cell is replaced.

mongolianRegression.guard: This accepted regression example does not support another synthetic ID or imply that any other retail effect needs the same companion shape.

query.mode: foreground-read-only against a freshly repaired disposable project
query.result: All three exact targets resolved to complete decompiled bodies after the pinned repair gates passed.

currentEvidence.method: One foreground read-only exact-function query against a freshly copied project after the pinned Xenon-thunk, function-rebuild, generated-seed, and split-reference repair chain passed all gates; narrow generated definitions corroborated the three recovered bodies.

terrainYieldBoundary.result: The three component accessors read the terrain discriminator, request the accepted cumulative UEA lookup for the matching retail ID, and add the named amount to that component's base tile yield when active.
terrainYieldBoundary.qualification: This static owner evidence establishes the six retail terrain-yield effects in these three exact accessors. It does not prove display, AI, save, scenario, multiplayer, or runtime parity; enumerate every terrain-yield consumer; provide a generic tile API; authorize a synthetic UEA, ABI, source edit, mod, runtime probe, or game launch.

currentEvidence.method: Synthesis of accepted topic manifests and catalogs, the accepted 95-site generated call inventory plus its merged-call corrections for UEA 12, 16, and 28, narrow exact generated callsite verification, the completed Mongolian direct-owner repair evidence, foreground read-only current-image word queries for the UEA 1 road cost, UEA 3/12/55 movement, UEA 8 growth, UEA 13 attack, UEA 23 Great Person, UEA 42 Anarchy-immunity, UEA 47 reserve-interest, and UEA 50 new-Warrior veteran paths, plus one repaired-project exact-function query for the six terrain-yield UEAs; no runtime action was performed.
currentEvidence.qualification: The catalog leaves 12 distinct retail IDs and 16 retail cells unknown. The UEA25 city Gold contribution has an effect-specific query/result/store connection; its separate rush-rate and valuation consumers do not replace that income owner. Lookup-literal coverage remains search guidance rather than ownership evidence.

guards: Do not infer an effect owner from a retail table ID, player-facing description, or lookup literal alone.
Do not convert an unknown classification into shared ownership merely because another effect in the same family uses the lookup.
Do not treat the accepted Horseback Riding mixed companion as a generic synthetic-UEA design pattern.
Do not claim complete UI, AI, save, scenario, multiplayer, or runtime parity from static owner classification.
conclusion: Effect-specific accepted evidence classifies 32 distinct retail UEA IDs covering 47 cells as shared cumulative-lookup effects, UEA 40 covering one cell as a direct civilization/effect path, no native retail ID as mixed, and 12 IDs covering 16 cells as unknown. UEA 1 is owned by RoadBuildCostLookup with matching half-cost arithmetic in the city-update command path. BuildingWonderProductionCostLookup owns UEA 18, 19, 20, and 24 through exact Courthouse, Barracks, Library, and wonder-range cost branches. EffectiveUnitMovementLookup owns UEA 3, UEA 12, and UEA 55 on its ordinary composed return; UEA 12 reaches a merged common callsite and is no longer absent from the literal-request inventory. UEA 8 is owned by CityGrowthThresholdLookup, which applies the adjustment and arithmetic qualifications recorded in city-growth-threshold after the cumulative lookup succeeds. UEA 13 is owned by the effective attack accessor, which adds two for Cannon UnitType 17 after the cumulative lookup succeeds. UEA 23 is owned by the bounded accumulation path in 0x82D13978, which adds half of the retained signed contribution after its baseline add when the cumulative lookup succeeds. UEA 42 is owned by a separate bounded path in the same function, where an active cumulative lookup bypasses a four-halfword zeroing block under the proved local predicates. UEA 47 is owned by CalendarTurnAdvance, which applies the exact rounded 2-percent term to the stored reserve, with a separate read-side aggregate consumer at 0x82CF9F38. UEA 50 is owned by the bounded new-Warrior path, which increments runtime unit byte +0x05 and saturates it at veteran level two. The accepted Horseback Riding extension is the mixed companion regression example: its shared grant did not suppress the direct UEA-40 owner until a separate gate was proved. The repaired-project terrain query recovered complete food, production, and trade accessors: UEA 16 adds one Food on Plains, UEA 28 adds one Food on Sea, UEA 30 adds one Production in Forest, UEA 32 adds one Food and one Trade in Desert, UEA 41 adds one Production on Hills, and UEA 56 adds two Production on Mountains after the cumulative lookup succeeds. UEA 25 is owned by the selected CityUpdate Gold-contribution path: the cumulative query at 0x82D148BC gates a half-intermediate addition before the frame +0x7C store. Its sixteen rate consumers and three other valuation consumers retain distinct roles.
